sloka: समुद्रम् लन्घयित्वा तु घोरम् नद नदी पतिम् ।कृतम् हनुमता कर्म दुष्करम् तर्कयेत कः ॥६-९-११॥।।
transliteration: samudram langhayitvā tu ghoram nada nadī patim ।kṛtam hanumatā karma duṣkaram tarkayeta kaḥ ॥6-9-11॥।।

translations.english: "Hanuman has crossed over the ocean, a Lord of streams and rivers and arrived. Who can ever know or think of such a task in this world?"
